item.title: Istanpitta “Tre Fontane”
item.description:
Istanpitta &ldquo;Tre Fontane&rdquo; is a medieval instrumental dance.
It is preserved in the British Library manuscript Add MS 29987, an important fourteenth-century Italian source containing secular and sacred music. The manuscript also includes fifteen monophonic instrumental dances known as istanpitte, among which &ldquo;Tre Fontane&rdquo; appears.
Tre Fontane means &ldquo;three fountains.&rdquo; What survives of the work is its title and original single-line melody, so modern performances often add various accompanying instruments, leaving performers considerable room for interpretation.

item.title: Quatrième suite in A minor, Op. 1
item.description:
Philidor&rsquo;s Quatrième suite in A minor, Op. 1 is a French Baroque suite, centered on dance character and ornamented melodic writing. This version presents the distinct character and affect of each movement through the recorder.
Hsing-An Lee Recorder Recital in Hsinchu, Taiwan Recorder: Hsing-An Lee Harpsichord: Machiko Suto
